R1.rationale: Describes spacing work, without owning or explaining the request layer.

permissibleClaims.summary: Describes spacing work, without owning or explaining the request layer.

support.quote: I helped adjust spacing around the queue controls. I did not own the request layer and cannot explain its state transitions.

unknownCheckpoints.description: Request-sequencing ownership from an unknown speaker is unconfirmed.

prohibitedInferences: Do not expand the described actions into sole ownership, comprehensive coverage or independently verified success.

R2.rationale: Does not establish a personal diagnosis; unattributed diagnosis is context only.

permissibleClaims.summary: Does not establish a personal diagnosis; unattributed diagnosis is context only.

unknownCheckpoints.description: The unknown-speaker diagnosis and claimed fix cannot be attributed to the candidate.

prohibitedInferences: Do not turn missing or future-only evidence into a negative judgment of overall ability.
